# Workflows

Default target: Local

## Targets

### Local

Author tracked TypeScript locally. Run once only. No scheduled or triggered workflows. Inspect source and ignored outputs. Local state uses ignored SQLite. Secrets are environment pointers and provider costs are estimated before runs.

### Vercel Workflows

Author and validate in ~/projects/atlas-automation. Test via the repo harness. Deploy with the declared repo mechanism; the agent can execute it. Inspect via target-state.json. Runtime state lives on Vercel. Secrets are repo environment names; provider billing is usage based.
